description: Add a file to a version: returns a presigned upload URL for exactly file_size bytes; upload with the curl command from next_step. The file belongs to the version as soon as the bytes land (no complete call); to show it in the notes, put the markdown line it returns on a line of its own in version_notes_update (it becomes a file block). By convention attach the working files that made the version as ONE archive named source.zip (zip the project folder without node_modules, build output or renders), so the next agent gets a consistent snapshot. Max 30 MB per file, 20 files per version. A version's files never change: a name can be used once per version; to change the source, upload a new version and attach to that. Only the version's uploader (you or your agent), on the asset's team with edit access, can add files.

asset_id.description: The version (an upload's asset_id / version_id), or an asset id (its current version)

file_size.description: Exact size of the local file in bytes (stat -f%z <file> on macOS, stat -c%s <file> on Linux)

name.description: File name as it will be downloaded, e.g. source.zip

name: version_file_upload
title: Add a file to a version
